proposed_metrics.observable: Yield and peak force or moment, each direction
proposed_metrics.condition: Same declared extraction rule; use actual measured section/material/fixture and matching deformation coordinate.

proposed_metrics.observable: Yield and capping rotation, each direction
proposed_metrics.condition: Only resolved, measurable features. Unobserved peak or censored cap is a bound, not a passing point estimate.
Prespecify common displacement intervals and unloading segments; exclude instrument-invalid intervals only with documented masks.
For per-cycle E_obs >= max(measured noise energy,0.01*F_ref*u_ref); smaller loops use abs energy error/(F_ref*u_ref)<=0.01. Apply analogous noise floor to cumulative energy.
Matched full protocol and sampling; report each direction, all valid cycles, and holdout specimens separately.

proposed_metrics.observable: dt versus dt/2 peak drift, floor acceleration, base shear
proposed_metrics.condition: Each response channel of each representative full-duration pilot; acceleration at full rate with identical absolute/relative convention. Floors are proposed project normalization choices, not physical detection or capacity limits.
Common zero-input settling tail >=max(20 s,10*T1); signed mean over final max(5 s,2*T1). When abs(reference)>=0.005, additionally require relative difference<=0.10. Unsettled tail is unresolved.

proposed_metrics.observable: Elastic member flexibility / periods in analytical fixture
proposed_metrics.metric: relative error against independently calculated target
proposed_metrics.condition: Model-form matched fixture; test both bending axes and n=10/20 alternatives before any change. Not an empirical period formula target.

calibration_rules: Freeze extraction and metrics before fitting; score independent holdout specimens/protocols separately.
A domain needs an independent holdout or an explicitly supported transfer with independent evidence; matching nominal steel grade alone is insufficient.
Capping/postcap/residual/ultimate need observed evidence or a bounded response-domain restriction; terminated tests are not failure capacities.
Do not score synthetic recorder replay as experimental validation.
If uncertainty exceeds a proposed tolerance, revise the criterion prospectively with rationale and reviewer decision; retain original results.
A/K deterioration suppression and any pinching omission require explicit reviewed support.
Numerical nonfinite material behavior must be resolved or excluded from validated domain; never relabeled physical collapse.
gates: all required design checks pass, no fail or not_evaluated and no PROBE substitutes
numerical pilot and damping assessment meet reviewed limits
full duration and finite histories; failed/truncated remain separate
schema and real surrogate ingestion pass
RA/professor review recorded and explicit release decision
